Events appear as an animated chip in the status bar. When \"Show on cutout\" is enabled, the chip moves to a pill around the front camera cutout instead
When multiple events are active, swipe left or right on the chip or pill to cycle through them. A badge shows the total event count. Swiping also works while the expanded card is open
Tap the chip or pill to open an expanded card for the current event with controls and details. If more events are stacked, tap the expand button below the card to see them all

Swipe an expanded card left or right to dismiss that specific event and remove it from the Dynamic Bar. To collapse the entire stack back to the status bar without dismissing events, tap outside the cards or swipe up on the background
The chip also appears at the bottom of the lock screen, replacing the standard indication text with playback controls and quick actions
Long press the chip or pill to jump straight to these Dynamic Bar settings

With \"Show on cutout\" enabled, the pill hugs the camera cutout. When idle the right side collapses. Enable \"Collapse to ring\" to shrink the pill into an animated ring with event-specific animations

The keybox file will be permanently removed.

1. Obtain a valid keybox XML from a trusted source. Keyboxes are not provided; you must find one yourself.
2. Tap "Import keybox" and load the file.
3. Open "Manage target apps" and select Google Play Services and Google Play Store.
4. Set target mode to "Leaf" if your device has a working TEE, otherwise leave it as Auto.
5. Recheck your Play Integrity status.

Always delete the existing keybox before importing a new one. If Google revokes a keybox, it may still allow passing up to device integrity even though strong integrity will fail.
